topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Oh man, I can't even believe this. We were inseparable, spent every single day together, and now it feels like all those memories just... vanished? I just don’t get it. Like, I’ve been replaying all these moments in my head, thinking there’s some mistake, that maybe they’re just messing with me or something. But the way they said it, so matter-of-factly, it was clear they weren’t. I mean, how do you even start to process that? Part of me keeps thinking that once they hear a story or two, they’ll be like, “Oh yeah, I remember!” But what if they don’t? It’s just so weird, you know?
